versions.content: The assignment of communication to specific secure channels shall be configurable Status: DRAFT Description: Secure channels can be realized using various technologies. Therefore, an application may be deployed in projects supporting different kinds of secure channels. The communication of the application shall be assigned to the respective secure channel. Rationale: Increase flexibility of an Adaptive Application Dependencies: – Use Case: Specific communication shall be assigned to the appropriate secure channel. Supporting Material: –
